base: Editorial marketing art for NIVAR, an energy intelligence house. Photorealistic photographic study with restrained mineral, graphite and oxidized copper colors; directional natural light, tactile fine detail, modest film grain, no glossy stock-photo look. Anonymous illustrative scene, never a named real site. No logos, no readable text or numbers, no generated UI, no maps, no neon, no fake scientific instruments. Main subject stays in central 40 percent for responsive cropping.

specs.prompt: High oblique aerial photograph of a real-class concrete hydroelectric spillway and green reservoir edge, three controlled curtains of white water flowing toward the lower center, powerful geometry embedded in dark humid hills. Wide composition with concrete piers and water meeting on the centerline. Overcast silver light, no city or buildings invented around it.

Low cinematic view through an authentic outdoor high-voltage substation after rain: realistic porcelain bushings, gantries, stable steel geometry, wet aggregate yard. Focus on one central transformer bank and ceramic bushing stack, foreground structure partly occludes edges. Cold slate rainclouds, sparse amber service light, no electrical arcs. Hardware feels used and credible.

Long-lens landscape of a ridge wind farm, three realistic utility-scale three-bladed wind turbines diminishing in distance, central nearest turbine isolated against a warm dusty sky, tawny scrubland and long atmospheric bands. The scale of territory matters more than the machines. Quiet late afternoon, exceptionally composed, authentic rotor geometry.

A high oblique view over utility-scale photovoltaic arrays in an anonymous dry landscape. Correct repeating blue-black rectangular modules in parallel rows, a narrow service path bends through the center, beige-red soil and low plants meet the engineered field. Cloud shadow creates a diagonal veil over panels. Avoid infinite pattern artifacts, frame a finite installation.

View from a modest industrial rooftop at blue hour across a real-feeling midsize city: warm windows, a warehouse roof, a modest service transformer and distribution wires in foreground, concrete texture and distant luminous traffic. A human territory consuming energy, no futuristic skyline. Strong central horizon and layered depth, subdued editorial color.

Tight photographic macro of a bolted copper busbar joint inside a de-energized industrial electrical cabinet, correct rectangular copper bars and a single hex bolt with washer, tiny oxidation marks, grounded practical construction, black cable edge receding out of focus. Raking amber light across brushed copper, dark graphite enclosure. Frame like architectural material photography, no sparks.

Macro of a brown glazed porcelain suspension-insulator disc with fine rain beads, authentic metal coupling and conductor attachment at the edge of the image, wet green territory softly blurred behind. Material glaze, weather and contact are the story. Subtle warm reflection against cool rain light. Not a sculpture, not laboratory equipment.

An installed unbranded industrial three-phase electricity meter mounted inside a closed ordinary metal service cabinet, seen through a small clear inspection window with rain flecks. Realistic rectangular meter body, dark LCD intentionally unlit and unreadable, simple sealed lower terminal cover, no exposed energized wires. The cabinet is visibly mounted on a rough concrete wall at a commercial facility. Honest utilitarian engineering, center framed.

Extreme architectural close-up of a real powder-coated graphite outdoor electrical enclosure corner, one weatherproof metallic cable gland and black cable entering below, visible gasket seam, fine rain, worn fastener. Strong shadow, subtle metallic edge highlight. The framing makes the practical protective enclosure beautifully tactile; no screen, no gauges.

Overhead editorial photograph of two adult hands carefully comparing two ordinary energy-contract printouts on a warm mineral-white desk. The paper has only faint gray typographic texture fully below readable resolution. One translucent tracing sheet is aligned over the page, one unbranded graphite pencil rests diagonally. No visible faces, no coffee, no laptop. Central hands and paper, real creases, decisive angled window light.

Low raking macro view along the edge of three aligned off-white paper sheets on a graphite desk, translucent vellum top sheet gently lifted at one corner by an adult hand, fine fiber texture and a small copper binder clip. Page content is faint nonsemantic gray ruling only. Directional daylight passes through the translucent layer, making the underlying sheet visible. No legible letters, signatures or data.

Candid documentary-style photograph of an electrical engineer from behind at a safe distance in an ordinary industrial service corridor, examining a paper folder next to closed labeled-out-of-focus electrical cabinets. Adult with dark work clothes and realistic plain protective helmet, no staged pose. Focus on hand holding paper and physical installation, desaturated industrial green and warm paper. Every cabinet remains closed.

Quiet close editorial photograph of a reader's adult hand holding open a thick contemporary technical book, matte off-white paper, disciplined columns visible only as unreadable gray print texture, an abstract black line drawing on the facing page without labels. A soft violet pencil bookmark creates a single accent. Table is pale stone, strong shaded late-afternoon light, intimacy and seriousness without library clichés.

A thoughtful physical teaching still life on warm mineral paper: two translucent drafting-paper sheets overlap, showing a simple unlabeled sine curve on one sheet and a clean unlabeled regular rectangular grid on the other, graphite pencil at the margin, adult fingertips aligning the layers. No text, formulas, numbers or geographical shapes. The visual is about seeing relationships through layers. Crisp side light and real paper fibers.

High-craft monochrome editorial photogram, a real copper conductor and a porcelain insulator casting intersecting long geometric shadows onto warm uncoated paper, extremely cropped so it reads as a print composition rather than product catalog. Sparse deep charcoal and oxidized amber traces, elegant asymmetry, center anchored. No labels, no faux scientific decoration, no maps, no invented device.

Full-frame extremely subtle warm mineral-white uncoated paper texture, near-uniform ivory tone with microscopic natural fibers and slight tonal clouding, soft flat diffuse light, no folds, no stains, no visible large grain, no objects, no words. Designed as a quiet reading substrate whose texture does not compete with small text. Tactile contemporary paper, never antique parchment.

Full-frame macro of matte graphite powder-coated metal with extremely fine honest texture and a faint broad reflected warm amber light from beyond the frame. Almost-black brown-gray at edges, smooth tonal depth in central region, no scratches, no rust, no objects or patterns. Understated industrial surface suitable under dense data without harming readability.
